## SK Hynix Triples US Sales as Client Base Widens and Single-Customer Concentration Drops

Tripling US sales alongside customer diversification is a strong positive signal for SK Hynix's AI memory positioning and de-risks single-customer concentration — directly relevant as a competitive read against Samsung's memory recovery and as a demand-side confirmation for HBM in AI infrastructure builds.

- SK Hynix (000660.KS) has tripled its US sales, per Chosunbiz reporting.
- The growth is driven by a broader customer base, with explicit reduction in reliance on a single dominant buyer.
- Client diversification is framed as a structural improvement alongside the volume gain.
- No specific revenue figures or named customers are disclosed in the headline.
